Pharmaceutical companies, meanwhile, have little incentive to develop new antibiotics, which are used sparingly and therefore earn modest profits compared with drugs for chronic conditions. Public health experts warn that unless this economic logic is changed, routine surgeries and cancer treatments, which depend on effective infection control, could become dangerously risky. Responsible use of existing drugs, together with new funding models for research, is therefore urgent.

t: Identify the tense and voice of the sentence: "Antibiotics transformed medicine in the twentieth century..."
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: 'transformed' (V2) है और Subject 'Antibiotics' स्वयं क्रिया कर रहा है (medicine को बदल दिया)। 'was/were + V3' नहीं है, इसलिए यह Simple Past Tense का Active Voice है।

t: The word "aggravated" as used in the passage is closest in meaning to:
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Aggravate = किसी समस्या या स्थिति को और बिगाड़ देना। मरीज़ों, डॉक्टरों और किसानों की आदतें समस्या को और गंभीर बना देती हैं।

t: According to the passage, why do pharmaceutical companies have little incentive to develop new antibiotics?
o: Antibiotics are too harmful to patients.
Antibiotics are used sparingly and so earn modest profits.
Governments have banned research on them.
Chronic drugs are cheaper to manufacture.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज: "which are used sparingly and therefore earn modest profits compared with drugs for chronic conditions" – कम उपयोग होने से कमाई कम होती है, इसलिए कंपनियों की रुचि कम है।

t: What grammatical function does the clause "which depend on effective infection control" serve in the sentence?
o: Non-defining adjective clause modifying "routine surgeries and cancer treatments"
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: 'which' relative pronoun है और comma के बीच आया clause 'routine surgeries and cancer treatments' के बारे में अतिरिक्त जानकारी देता है। इसलिए यह Non-defining Adjective (Relative) Clause है।

t: Which of the following best describes the tone of the passage?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: लेखक एंटीबायोटिक प्रतिरोध के ख़तरे बताता है और अंत में 'urgent' कदम उठाने की बात करता है। इसलिए tone चेतावनी देने वाला और अत्यावश्यक (cautionary and urgent) है।

p: Meera had inherited the house along with its silences. Her grandmother had never spoken of the years before the Partition, and the rooms seemed to hold their breath whenever the subject approached. It was only when Meera began clearing the attic that she found the trunk, its lid swollen with damp and its brass clasp green with age. Inside lay a bundle of letters bound in a faded ribbon, written in a script she could barely read. She sat among the dust for hours, deciphering a word here and a phrase there, and slowly understood that the silence she had grown up with was not emptiness but a form of protection — a wall her grandmother had built, brick by careful brick, so that grief would not follow her into the new country.

t: The statement "Meera had inherited the house along with its silences" suggests that:
o: the house had been recently renovated
the house carried a history of unspoken family experiences
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: 'silences' को inherit करना एक आलंकारिक प्रयोग है – घर के साथ उसकी अनकही पारिवारिक यादें/दर्द भी मिले। इसे शाब्दिक अर्थ में नहीं लेना चाहिए।

t: The word "deciphering" as used in the passage most nearly means:
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Decipher = अस्पष्ट या कूट लिपि को पढ़कर अर्थ निकालना। मीरा धूल में बैठकर पुरानी लिखावट के एक-एक शब्द का अर्थ निकाल रही थी।

t: What did Meera finally understand about her grandmother's silence?
o: It showed that her grandmother had forgotten the past.
It was a form of protection against grief, not mere emptiness.
It was caused by her dislike of the new country.
It meant that the letters were unimportant.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज: "the silence... was not emptiness but a form of protection — a wall... so that grief would not follow her into the new country"। 'not A but B' में उत्तर B है।

t: In the phrase "written in a script she could barely read", the word "written" is used as:
o: a simple past verb with subject "she"
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: 'written' V3 है जो 'letters' की विशेषता बताता है (कैसे पत्र? जो ऐसी लिपि में लिखे थे जिसे वह मुश्किल से पढ़ पाती थी)। इसलिए यह Past Participle (Participial phrase) है।

t: Which of the following best describes the overall tone of the passage?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पुरानी यादों, दबे दर्द और अतीत की परतें खुलने के वर्णन से पैसेज का स्वर चिंतनशील और गंभीर (reflective and sombre) है।

pp: 1. Today, millions practise it for fitness, though its philosophical roots are often overlooked.
2. Classical texts such as Patanjali's Yoga Sutras, however, treat posture as only one limb of an eightfold path.
3. Yoga originated in ancient India as a discipline for uniting body, mind and spirit.
4. In 2014, the United Nations declared 21 June the International Day of Yoga.
5. Over centuries, its physical postures, or asanas, came to dominate its popular image abroad.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: 3 उत्पत्ति → 5 'popular image abroad' (आसनों का वर्चस्व) → 2 'however' (5 का विरोध: प्राचीन ग्रंथों में आसन केवल एक अंग) → 4 2014 की UN घोषणा → 1 'Today' वर्तमान स्थिति। सही क्रम 3-5-2-4-1।

pp: 1. By morning, the withered shoots had begun to stand upright again.
2. The monsoon arrived late that year, and the fields lay cracked and thirsty.
3. He ran out to the field, laughing like a child, as the parched soil drank greedily.
4. One night, thunder rolled across the horizon and heavy drops began to fall.
5. Ramesh, a small farmer, watched the sky each evening with growing despair.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: 2 स्थिति (देर से आया मानसून) → 5 रमेश की निराशा (2 के बाद नायक का परिचय) → 4 रात की बारिश → 3 'He ran out' (4 की प्रतिक्रिया) → 1 'By morning' (अंतिम परिणाम)। सही क्रम 2-5-4-3-1।

pp: Not until
P: did she realise
Q: she had left the city
R: she had loved it
S: how much
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: सही वाक्य: "Not until she had left the city did she realise how much she had loved it." 'Not until' के बाद clause (Q), फिर inversion (P), फिर 'how much' (S) और अंतिम clause (R)।

pp: The ancient temple,
P: continues to attract
Q: who travel from distant lands
R: though battered by centuries of neglect,
S: pilgrims and historians alike
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: सही वाक्य: "The ancient temple, though battered by centuries of neglect, continues to attract pilgrims and historians alike who travel from distant lands." Subject के बाद concessive phrase (R), क्रिया (P), object (S), और उसे modify करने वाला relative clause (Q)।

pp: S1: The train crawled through the fog as the passengers dozed.
A. Suddenly, a sharp whistle pierced the silence, and the compartment jolted awake.
B. An old woman by the window peered out and murmured that they must be nearing the river.
C. Moments later, the dim lights of a small station emerged from the mist.
D. Nobody spoke, yet every face betrayed a quiet relief.
S6: The journey had been long, but they had finally arrived.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: S1 में यात्री ऊँघ रहे हैं → A अचानक सीटी → B बूढ़ी महिला का अनुमान → C 'Moments later' स्टेशन की रोशनी → D सबके चेहरे पर राहत → S6। 'Moments later' के बाद ही स्टेशन दिखना चाहिए, इसलिए C, D से पहले आएगा।

pp: S1: Public libraries were once regarded as quiet storehouses of books.
A. Today, many have reinvented themselves as community hubs offering internet access, workshops and meeting spaces.
B. This transformation was driven by the realisation that information now flows through many channels besides print.
C. Some critics lament the loss of silence, but few deny the benefits.
D. For households that cannot afford private internet connections, this is especially valuable.
S6: The library, in short, has changed its form while keeping its purpose.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: A आज की स्थिति → B 'This transformation' (A का परिवर्तन) → D 'this is especially valuable' (B के बदलाव का लाभ) → C 'but few deny the benefits' (लाभों के बाद आलोचना का जवाब) → S6 'in short'। सही क्रम ABDC।

pp: 1. After independence, she served as the Governor of the United Provinces.
2. She later joined the freedom struggle, becoming a close associate of Mahatma Gandhi.
3. Born in Hyderabad in 1879, Sarojini Naidu showed a gift for poetry from an early age.
4. In 1925, she became the first Indian woman to preside over the Indian National Congress.
5. Her lyrical verse earned her the title "Nightingale of India."
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: जीवन का काल-क्रम: 3 जन्म और कविता की प्रतिभा → 5 कविता से 'Nightingale of India' की उपाधि → 2 'later' स्वतंत्रता आंदोलन में शामिल → 4 1925 में कांग्रेस की अध्यक्ष → 1 आज़ादी के बाद राज्यपाल। सही क्रम 3-5-2-4-1।

p: India's space programme has (1) _____ remarkable milestones despite a modest budget. The Mars Orbiter Mission, launched in 2013, (2) _____ India the first Asian nation to reach Martian orbit on its maiden attempt, at a cost lower than that of many Hollywood films. Engineers credit this success to frugal design, careful reuse of existing technology and a culture of (3) _____ improvisation. Today, private start-ups are (4) _____ the sector, building small rockets and satellites for commercial customers. Analysts believe that this partnership between government and industry will (5) _____ India's position in the global space economy.

t: What should come in blank (1)?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: "has (1) _____ remarkable milestones" – 'has' के बाद Present Perfect के लिए V3 चाहिए: has achieved। Achieve (V1), achieving (V-ing) और achievement (noun) यहाँ ग़लत हैं। Hindi Meaning: प्राप्त करना.

t: What should come in blank (2)?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: "The Mars Orbiter Mission... (2) _____ India the first Asian nation to reach Martian orbit" – 'make + object + complement' संरचना में 'made' (बना दिया) सही है। बाकी विकल्प व्याकरण और अर्थ दोनों में फिट नहीं होते। Hindi Meaning: बना देना.

t: What should come in blank (3)?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: "a culture of (3) _____ improvisation" – noun 'improvisation' से पहले विशेषण चाहिए: resourceful (साधन-संपन्न/कुशल)। Resourcefully adverb है, resource और resourcefulness noun हैं। Hindi Meaning: कुशल / तरकीबी.

t: What should come in blank (4)?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: "private start-ups are (4) _____ the sector" – 'are' के बाद Present Continuous के लिए V-ing चाहिए: are entering। Enter (V1), entered (V2/V3) और entry (noun) यहाँ व्याकरण के अनुसार सही नहीं हैं। Hindi Meaning: प्रवेश करना.

t: What should come in blank (5)?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: "will (5) _____ India's position" – 'will' के बाद Verb की V1 चाहिए और अर्थ 'मज़बूत करना' चाहिए: strengthen। Strength (noun), strongly (adverb) और strongest (superlative) यहाँ फिट नहीं होते। Hindi Meaning: मज़बूत करना.

p: Nearly three-quarters of the world's leading food crops depend, at least partly, on animal pollination, yet pollinators are declining at an alarming rate. Habitat loss, pesticide use and climate change have reduced the abundance of bees, butterflies and other insects that carry pollen from flower to flower. The consequences extend beyond agriculture. Wild plants that rely on these insects produce fewer seeds, which in turn deprives birds and small mammals of food, setting off a chain of ecological disruption. Some farmers have responded by renting managed honeybee colonies, but scientists caution that this practice cannot replace the diverse wild pollinators, each of which visits different flowers at different times. A more durable approach, they suggest, would be to preserve hedgerows, plant wildflower strips and reduce the use of harmful chemicals. Such measures cost relatively little, yet they require farmers to view their land not merely as a factory for crops but as a shared habitat.

t: Identify the tense and voice of the sentence: "Wild plants that rely on these insects produce fewer seeds..."
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: क्रिया 'produce' (V1) है और Subject 'Wild plants' स्वयं बीज पैदा कर रहे हैं। यह एक सामान्य/स्थायी तथ्य है, इसलिए यह Simple Present Tense का Active Voice है।

t: The word "abundance" as used in the passage is closest in meaning to:
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Abundance = प्रचुरता/बड़ी मात्रा। 'reduced the abundance of bees' = मधुमक्खियों की भरपूर संख्या घट गई। Scarcity इसका विलोम है।

t: According to the passage, why can managed honeybee colonies not fully replace wild pollinators?
o: Honeybees cannot carry pollen between flowers.
Farmers refuse to rent honeybee colonies.
Wild pollinators are diverse and each visits different flowers at different times.
Wild pollinators are cheaper to maintain.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज: "this practice cannot replace the diverse wild pollinators, each of which visits different flowers at different times" – विविधता ही उनकी भूमिका को अपूरणीय बनाती है।

t: What grammatical function does the clause "which in turn deprives birds and small mammals of food" serve in the sentence?
o: Noun clause functioning as the subject
Defining clause that identifies a particular bird
Non-defining relative clause adding information about the preceding idea
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: 'which' से शुरू होने वाला यह clause comma के बाद आया है और पिछले विचार (पौधों का कम बीज पैदा करना) का परिणाम बताता है। यह Non-defining Relative Clause है जो अतिरिक्त जानकारी जोड़ता है।

t: Which of the following would be the most suitable title for the passage?
o: How to Rent Honeybee Colonies Profitably
Silent Orchards: The Decline of Pollinators and Why It Matters
A History of Hedgerows in Europe
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज पराग-कारकों की गिरावट, उसके कारण, पारिस्थितिक परिणाम और समाधान – पूरे विषय को कवर करता है। बाकी शीर्षक केवल एक छोटे बिंदु या असंबद्ध विषय पर हैं।

p: Mr. Verma had taught in the same dim classroom for thirty years, and in that time the building had acquired the habits of his personality: the windows that stuck, the chalk dust that settled on every surface like a slow, white snow, the single clock that ran seven minutes behind and which he refused to correct. "Time," he would say to bored students, "is generous in a school; it forgives the late and rewards the patient." When the new principal announced that the old building would be demolished, the staff exchanged polite, worried glances. Mr. Verma said nothing. That evening, however, he stayed behind after everyone had left and, for the first time in three decades, stood at the back of the room and looked at it as a student might — and realised how small, and how full, it was.

t: The phrase "the building had acquired the habits of his personality" suggests that:
o: the building and the teacher had grown alike over the years
the building had been designed by the teacher
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: यहाँ इमारत को व्यक्तित्व की 'आदतें' अपनाते दिखाया गया है – यह साहित्यिक अलंकार (personification) है, जो बताता है कि तीस वर्षों में इमारत और शिक्षक एक-दूसरे जैसे हो गए।

t: Mr. Verma's refusal to correct the clock best reflects his:
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: उसका कथन "Time is generous in a school; it forgives the late and rewards the patient" बताता है कि वह समय को लेकर सहज और धैर्यवान दृष्टिकोण रखता है, इसलिए वह घड़ी ठीक नहीं करता।

t: Mr. Verma's silence at the principal's announcement suggests that he:
o: did not care about the building
was deeply affected but did not express it openly
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: वह चुप रहता है, पर उसी शाम अकेले रुककर कक्षा को नई नज़र से देखता है। इससे स्पष्ट है कि वह भीतर से बहुत प्रभावित था, पर उसने भावनाएँ ज़ाहिर नहीं कीं।

t: Identify the tense of the sentence: "Mr. Verma had taught in the same dim classroom for thirty years."
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: 'had + V3 (taught)' की संरचना Past Perfect Tense की है। 'for thirty years' अवधि बताता है और क्रिया पैसेज में बताए गए बाद के भूतकाल से पहले की है।

t: Which of the following best describes the tone of the passage?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पुरानी इमारत, चॉक की धूल, घड़ी और शिक्षक की आदतों का कोमल वर्णन, तथा अंत में 'how small, and how full' का भाव – ये सब पैसेज को स्मृति-भरा और शांत चिंतनशील बनाते हैं।

pp: 1. Hardy, astonished, arranged for him to travel to England.
2. Ramanujan returned to India in 1919 in failing health and died the following year at thirty-two.
3. Srinivasa Ramanujan was born in Erode in 1887 into a modest family.
4. In 1913, he wrote to the Cambridge mathematician G. H. Hardy, enclosing some of his results.
5. With almost no formal training, he filled notebooks with startling theorems.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: 3 जन्म और पृष्ठभूमि → 5 औपचारिक प्रशिक्षण के बिना प्रमेय → 4 1913 में हार्डी को पत्र → 1 हार्डी का इंग्लैंड बुलाना (4 का परिणाम) → 2 भारत वापसी और निधन। सही क्रम 3-5-4-1-2।

pp: 1. Just as he prepared to turn back, the net grew heavy and began to thrash.
2. Smiling, he rowed home, certain that patience had been rewarded once more.
3. The old fisherman cast his net as the first light touched the water.
4. He hauled it in with trembling hands and found it brimming with silver fish.
5. For hours, nothing came except weed and driftwood.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: कहानी का क्रम: 3 मछुआरे का जाल डालना → 5 'For hours' घंटों तक कुछ नहीं मिला → 1 'Just as he prepared to turn back' अचानक जाल भारी → 4 जाल खींचना → 2 घर लौटना। सही क्रम 3-5-1-4-2।

pp: It was only after
P: the storm had passed
Q: that the villagers
R: the extent of the damage
S: could assess
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: सही वाक्य: "It was only after the storm had passed that the villagers could assess the extent of the damage." 'It was only after' के बाद समय का clause (P), फिर 'that' वाला भाग (Q), फिर क्रिया (S) और object (R)।

pp: The film,
P: nevertheless criticised
Q: for its slow pace
R: which won three national awards,
S: was
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: सही वाक्य: "The film, which won three national awards, was nevertheless criticised for its slow pace." Subject के बाद relative clause (R), फिर 'was' (S), फिर 'nevertheless criticised' (P) और कारण (Q)।

pp: S1: The village fair began at dawn, as it had for generations.
A. Stalls selling bangles, sweets and wooden toys lined the dusty lane.
B. Children darted between them, clutching coins and shrieking with delight.
C. By evening, the lanterns were lit and the sound of drums drifted over the fields.
D. Meanwhile, elders seated beneath the peepal tree watched with quiet satisfaction.
S6: Another year had passed, but the fair, like the village, remained unchanged.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: A मेले की दुकानें → B 'between them' (दुकानों के बीच बच्चे) → D 'Meanwhile' (उसी समय बुज़ुर्ग) → C 'By evening' (दिन का अंत) → S6। 'By evening' हमेशा दिन के वर्णन के बाद आता है। सही क्रम ABDC।

pp: S1: The humble potato has a surprisingly dramatic history.
A. Native to the Andes, it was domesticated there thousands of years ago.
B. Spanish explorers carried it to Europe in the sixteenth century, where it was initially viewed with suspicion.
C. In time, however, its high yield and nutritional value made it a staple of European diets.
D. Ireland's heavy reliance on a single variety proved disastrous when blight struck in the 1840s.
S6: The potato thus fed millions but also exposed the dangers of dependence on one crop.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: A उत्पत्ति (Andes) → B यूरोप में आगमन और शुरुआती संदेह → C 'however' से संदेह के विपरीत लोकप्रियता → D आयरलैंड की निर्भरता और आपदा → S6 'thus'। सही क्रम ABCD।

pp: 1. As chairman of the Drafting Committee, he played a central role in shaping the Constitution of India.
2. Born in 1891 in Mhow, Bhimrao Ambedkar faced discrimination from childhood because of his caste.
3. Shortly before his death in 1956, he embraced Buddhism along with thousands of followers.
4. He returned to India determined to fight caste oppression through law and education.
5. Despite these hardships, he pursued higher education at Columbia University and the London School of Economics.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: 2 जन्म और बचपन का भेदभाव → 5 'Despite these hardships' (2 की कठिनाइयाँ) उच्च शिक्षा → 4 'returned to India' संघर्ष का संकल्प → 1 संविधान निर्माण में भूमिका → 3 अंत में बौद्ध धर्म ग्रहण (1956)। सही क्रम 2-5-4-1-3।

p: Over the last decade, India has witnessed a (1) _____ rise in the number of women entering higher education. However, this has not (2) _____ translated into jobs, as female labour-force participation remains stubbornly low. Social expectations, unsafe commutes and a lack of childcare facilities often (3) _____ women from seeking employment. Several states have therefore introduced flexible work schemes and hostels for working women, (4) _____ to bridge the gap. Experts caution that real change will require not just policy but also a shift in (5) _____ attitudes.

t: What should come in blank (1)?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: "a (1) _____ rise" – 'a' के बाद और noun 'rise' से पहले विशेषण चाहिए: steady (लगातार/स्थिर)। Steadily adverb है, steadied V2/V3 है और steadiness noun है। Hindi Meaning: लगातार / स्थिर.

t: What should come in blank (2)?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: "this has not (2) _____ translated into jobs" – 'has not' के बाद क्रिया (translated) को modify करने के लिए Adverb चाहिए: necessarily (अनिवार्य रूप से)। 'has not necessarily translated' = ज़रूरी नहीं कि नौकरियों में बदला हो। Hindi Meaning: अनिवार्य रूप से.

t: What should come in blank (3)?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: "often (3) _____ women from seeking employment" – 'from' के साथ 'discourage ... from' (रोकना/हतोत्साहित करना) का प्रयोग होता है। Encourage/Permit/Invite के साथ 'from' अर्थ और व्याकरण दोनों में ग़लत है। Hindi Meaning: हतोत्साहित करना.

t: What should come in blank (4)?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: "...hostels for working women, (4) _____ to bridge the gap" – comma के बाद participle phrase चाहिए जो उद्देश्य बताए: aiming to bridge (अंतर पाटने के उद्देश्य से)। Aim/aims क्रिया-रूप हैं जो पूरे वाक्य में नया verb जोड़ देंगे, जो ग़लत है। Hindi Meaning: लक्ष्य रखना.

t: What should come in blank (5)?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: "a shift in (5) _____ attitudes" – noun 'attitudes' से पहले विशेषण चाहिए: societal (समाज-संबंधी)। Society/societies noun हैं और socially adverb है। Hindi Meaning: सामाजिक.

p: Self-help groups, typically composed of ten to twenty women from similar backgrounds, have emerged as a quiet engine of rural change in India. Members pool small savings, lend to one another at modest interest and gradually build a fund that can finance household needs or small enterprises. Because loans are guaranteed by the group's collective reputation rather than by physical collateral, women who were once excluded from formal banking can now access credit. Studies indicate that participation raises household income, improves children's nutrition and strengthens women's voice in family decisions. Nonetheless, the model is not free from criticism. Some analysts note that the pressure to repay on time may push vulnerable members into informal debt, while others point out that many groups stagnate once initial enthusiasm fades, lacking the skills to expand beyond petty trade. For the movement to realise its full potential, banks, local governments and training institutions must offer sustained support rather than one-time assistance.

t: Identify the tense and voice of the sentence: "Members pool small savings, lend to one another at modest interest..."
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: 'pool' और 'lend' दोनों V1 रूप में हैं और Subject 'Members' स्वयं बचत जमा कर रहे हैं और उधार दे रहे हैं। यह एक नियमित/सामान्य प्रक्रिया है, इसलिए Simple Present Tense का Active Voice है।

t: The word "stagnate" as used in the passage is closest in meaning to:
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Stagnate = रुक जाना, विकास या गतिविधि बंद हो जाना। 'groups stagnate once initial enthusiasm fades' = शुरुआती उत्साह ख़त्म होने पर समूह आगे बढ़ना बंद कर देते हैं।

t: According to the passage, how can women access credit without physical collateral?
o: Banks lend only to women with property.
Loans are guaranteed by the group's collective reputation.
The government pays all loans in advance.
Women borrow from moneylenders at low interest.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज: "Because loans are guaranteed by the group's collective reputation rather than by physical collateral, women... can now access credit." 'rather than' से स्पष्ट है कि सामूहिक साख गिरवी का काम करती है।

t: What grammatical function does the clause "who were once excluded from formal banking" serve in the sentence?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: 'who' एक relative pronoun है और clause 'women' की पहचान बताता है (कौन-सी महिलाएँ? जिन्हें पहले बैंकिंग से बाहर रखा गया था)। इसलिए यह Adjective (Relative) Clause है।

t: Which of the following best summarises the author's view of self-help groups?
o: They are beneficial but need sustained support to overcome their limitations.
They have failed and should be abandoned.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: लेखक पहले लाभ गिनाता है (आय, पोषण, महिलाओं की भागीदारी), फिर आलोचनाएँ (कर्ज़ का दबाव, ठहराव) बताता है और अंत में 'sustained support' की सलाह देता है – यही संतुलित दृष्टिकोण है।

p: Arjun had always believed that courage was a loud thing — a shout, a raised fist, a sudden leap into danger. It was his grandfather who taught him otherwise. The old man, whose legs had weakened after an accident years before, rose each morning before dawn, gripped the wooden rail beside his bed and, with a patience that bordered on stubbornness, pulled himself up. It took him nearly ten minutes. He never complained; he merely breathed slowly, his knuckles white, and when at last he stood, he would glance at Arjun with a small, ironic smile, as if inviting him to notice that the day's first victory had already been won. Arjun began to see that there was a quieter courage, one that lived not in the dramatic moment but in the daily refusal to give up.

t: What did Arjun believe about courage at the beginning of the passage?
o: That it was quiet and patient
That it was loud and dramatic
That it came only with age
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज की पहली पंक्ति: "Arjun had always believed that courage was a loud thing — a shout, a raised fist, a sudden leap into danger." बाद में दादा उसे दूसरा रूप सिखाते हैं।

t: The phrase "a patience that bordered on stubbornness" implies that the grandfather's patience was:
o: so firm that it resembled a refusal to give way
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: 'Bordered on' = लगभग वैसा ही होना। उसका धैर्य इतना दृढ़ था कि लगभग ज़िद जैसा लगता था – यानी हार न मानने का अटल संकल्प।

t: The grandfather's "small, ironic smile" suggests that he:
o: was quietly aware of how modest the day's victory appeared
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Ironic smile = हल्की, आत्म-जागरूक मुस्कान। वह जानता है कि उठ खड़ा होना बाहर से छोटी बात लगती है, फिर भी उसके लिए वही दिन की पहली जीत है।

t: Identify the tense of the sentence: "Arjun had always believed that courage was a loud thing."
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: 'had always believed' = had + V3 है, जो Past Perfect Tense है। यह उस सोच को दर्शाता है जो पैसेज की घटनाओं से पहले से मौजूद थी।

t: Which of the following best captures the message of the passage?
o: True courage can lie in quiet, daily perseverance.
Courage is shown only in dramatic acts.
Courage should always be loud to be noticed.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: अंतिम वाक्य: "a quieter courage, one that lived not in the dramatic moment but in the daily refusal to give up" – यही पैसेज का संदेश है।

pp: 1. Rajasthan, one of India's driest states, has long struggled with scarce and erratic rainfall.
2. In the 1980s, the revival of johads transformed several parched villages in Alwar district.
3. Rivers that had vanished for decades began to flow once again.
4. Traditionally, communities built johads, small earthen dams that capture monsoon runoff.
5. These structures allow water to seep into the ground, recharging wells that had run dry.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: 1 समस्या (कम वर्षा) → 4 पारंपरिक समाधान (johad) → 5 'These structures' (4 के johads) का कार्य → 2 1980 के दशक में पुनरुद्धार → 3 नदियों का फिर बहना (अंतिम परिणाम)। सही क्रम 1-4-5-2-3।

pp: 1. When she finished, the applause rose like a wave and carried away her fear.
2. She took a deep breath and began, her voice faltering at first.
3. Nisha had practised the speech for weeks, yet her hands trembled as she stepped onto the stage.
4. Gradually, the words gathered strength, and the audience leaned forward.
5. The hall fell silent, and every face seemed to be turned towards her.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: कहानी का क्रम: 3 मंच पर घबराहट → 5 हॉल की चुप्पी → 2 'began, voice faltering' → 4 'Gradually' आवाज़ का मज़बूत होना → 1 'When she finished' तालियाँ। सही क्रम 3-5-2-4-1।

pp: Had the authorities
P: could have been
Q: acted promptly,
R: minimised
S: the flood damage
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: सही वाक्य: "Had the authorities acted promptly, the flood damage could have been minimised." 'Had + subject' वाला conditional clause (Q) पहले, फिर main clause: subject (S), auxiliary (P), V3 (R)।

pp: Despite his reputation
P: by his students
Q: the teacher
R: for being strict,
S: was adored
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: सही वाक्य: "Despite his reputation for being strict, the teacher was adored by his students." 'Despite his reputation' के बाद 'for being strict' (R), फिर subject (Q), क्रिया (S) और 'by' वाला agent (P)।

pp: S1: Anita found the old diary while cleaning her late mother's cupboard.
A. She sat down on the floor and began to read, forgetting about the cleaning altogether.
B. Its pages, yellowed and brittle, were filled with recipes, small sketches and half-finished poems.
C. Gradually, she realised that she was meeting a young woman she had never known.
D. Tucked between two pages was a pressed marigold, still faintly fragrant.
S6: When she finally closed the diary, she felt that she had been given a precious gift.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: A डायरी पढ़ना शुरू करना → B 'Its pages' (डायरी के पन्नों का वर्णन) → D 'between two pages' (B के पन्नों में फूल) → C 'Gradually, she realised' (निष्कर्षात्मक अनुभूति) → S6। सही क्रम ABDC।

pp: S1: Sleep is often sacrificed first when life becomes busy.
A. Yet research consistently shows that sleep-deprived people make poorer decisions and react more slowly.
B. In the long run, chronic lack of sleep is linked to heart disease, diabetes and depression.
C. Many treat it as a luxury, assuming that a few extra hours of work are worth the cost.
D. Experts therefore urge people to regard sleep as a necessity, as vital as food and exercise.
S6: A well-rested mind, after all, is the most productive tool anyone owns.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: C लोगों की मान्यता (नींद विलासिता) → A 'Yet' (शोध से विरोधी तथ्य) → B 'In the long run' (दीर्घकालिक असर) → D 'therefore' (विशेषज्ञों की सलाह) → S6। सही क्रम CABD।

pp: 1. Her journey has since inspired a generation of young athletes from small towns.
2. She won her first World Amateur Boxing Championship title in 2002.
3. In 2012, she also won a bronze medal at the London Olympics.
4. Born in a farming family in Manipur, Mary Kom took up boxing despite her family's reservations.
5. She went on to add several more world titles, becoming an icon for women's sport.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: 4 पारिवारिक पृष्ठभूमि और शुरुआत → 2 पहला विश्व ख़िताब (2002) → 5 'went on to add' (और ख़िताब) → 3 'also' (2012 का ओलंपिक कांस्य) → 1 'has since inspired' (प्रेरणा, अंतिम प्रभाव)। सही क्रम 4-2-5-3-1।
